content.text:
The drawing shows a benzene ring with a carboxylic acid group (CO2H) at the top and a trifluoromethoxy group (OCF3) at the bottom. The two substituents sit on opposite ends of the ring, so they are para to each other. This is 4-(trifluoromethoxy)benzoic acid.

SMILES: OC(=O)c1ccc(OC(F)(F)F)cc1
